text:
Maya: Quick poll — what's one food you wish you could force yourself to love (but just can't)? I'm trying to expand my palate 😂
Jamal: Brussels sprouts. Tried roasting, bacon, balsamic, therapy. No.
Priya: Cilantro. It's like my mouth thinks it's soap. Genetics hate me.
Zoe: Blue cheese. I appreciate it is intense but can't make the leap.
Ben: Black coffee. I can drink it in emergencies only.
Maya: Also anchovies? I want to enjoy Caesar dressing but the tiny fish brain blocks me.
Jamal: :face_with_monocle: anchovies are the personality of a dressing
Priya: @Zoe same on blue cheese. Also, olive oil haters unite :olive:
Zoe: Hot take: some blue cheese on honeyed pear = borderline edible for me
Ben: Re: black coffee — try single-origin pour-over, makes a difference sometimes.
Maya: OK group consensus: cilantro and brussels sprouts are the villains. Any tips to trick yourself into liking them?
Luca: For brussels — shred and char in a hot pan with soy + lemon. Texture change helps.
snack-bot: Poll created: Which would you choose to try again? (1) Brussels sprouts (2) Cilantro (3) Blue cheese (4) Anchovies — Vote: https://poll.link/abc123
Maya: :thumbsup: votes in. Also sending my 'growing up trick' — mix a little into something you love.
Jamal: If you truly hate something, don't force it. Your life is short. Eat the things you love :shrug:
Priya: :heart: agreed. but still curious if anyone overcame cilantro.
Zoe: My grandma made a chimichurri-like sauce with parsley not cilantro. Swap worked for me.
Maya: Thanks all. Also, this thread is food therapy. 10/10 would talk again :taco:
Ben: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/food-funny-xyz (pretend I posted the gif)
snack-bot: Reminder: Lunch tomorrow is tacos in the kitchen @channel
